tasks.name: p2p-hook
tasks.scopedGoal:
Implement CAM-23: Add `useP2PConnection` hook. Read bootstrap docs at `.orchestrate/project-priority/bootstrap/phase1-architecture.md` and `.orchestrate/project-priority/bootstrap/issue-specs.md`.

Create `src/hooks/useP2PConnection.ts` mirroring `useGameConnection` return shape, using `useServerMessages`, `createLanHostRelay`, and `createLanGuestTransport` from `src/p2p/lan-transport.ts`. Host mode instantiates `GameHost` and wires LAN peers as `HostPeer`. Guest mode connects via endpoint param.

Update `src/app/play/[roomId]/page.tsx` to use `useP2PConnection` when `mode=local`, passing `host=1`/`join=1`/`endpoint` query params. Keep online mode (`mode` absent or `mode=online`) on `useGameConnection` unchanged.

Add unit tests. Mark CAM-23 Done in Linear when complete.
acceptance: mode=local host/guest lobby works over LAN transport
Tests pass: pnpm test src/p2p/ src/hooks/useP2PConnection.test.ts src/game/host.test.ts
